SPEC3.fold_rule: int(sha1(concept_id).hexdigest(), 16) % 10 < 7 -> screen else heldout (ds5 metadata_fold authoritative)

populations.MAIN: frozen MAIN rule after the frozen replacement rule

prediction.BASE: vendored analysis_predict BASELINE = BASE_A + BASE_B + BASE_C + EXTRA
prediction.FULL: BASE + [closure_resT (R1a OLS refit inside each training fold), constraint]
prediction.cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, groups=concept) x 5 seeds; OOF scores averaged over seeds
prediction.label: E_up
prediction.model: StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1, class_weight balanced (vendored _clf('logit'))

SPEC3.r1a_fit_set: arm main, fold screen, finite closure, age >= -2 (all years); NO label column in scope
SPEC3.r1a_na_rule: mean-fill (screen fit-set mean) + NA dummy for any covariate with missing values (beta_sim_rar and H by declaration; novelty / new_relation_rate if NA occurs)
SPEC3.verdict_rules: BROKERAGE if ALL of: S_res < 0 and CI_res excludes 0; |S_res| >= 0.5*|S_raw|; S(closure_persist) < 0; S(constraint) < 0; (CI(closure_persist) excludes 0 OR CI(constraint) excludes 0). TURNOVER if ALL of: CI_res includes 0; |S_res| < 0.5*|S_raw|; R1b null (CI(closure_persist) includes 0). MIXED otherwise. R1b NON-ESTIMABLE (< 10 matched treated with finite closure_persist in k=-3..0) counts as null for TURNOVER and as failing for BROKERAGE. S_raw = S(closure), S_res = S(closure_resT), cell = MAIN x all x E_up x route all. Flags never change the label: R1c_degree_driven, R1b_selection, H_sensitive, underpowered, fresh_replication, route_B_only agreement, R1a_model_dependent.

note: written before any label (Step 5) is computed; labels, matches and outcomes come later
